title: D3G: Diverse Demographic Data Generation Increases Zero-Shot Image Classification Accuracy within Multimodal Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing top-1 zero-shot image classification accuracy across distinct racial groups (e.g., White, Black, Latino, East Asian) using multimodal models like CLIP and the proposed D3G weighted-embedding method.
Measuring discrepancies in zero-shot image classification accuracy between male and female demographic groups to quantify the model's representation and prediction fairness.
Assessing zero-shot image classification performance disparities across multiple age brackets (e.g., 0-2, 20-29, 70+) within the IdenProf dataset augmented with FairFace labels.
